Keep the bright painted meadow, original white round monster with dark eyes and pink cheeks, and the game's original apple graphics recognizably unchanged in drawing style. The grassy game world remains the main background. Include a smaller neat inset showing an authentic crop of the supplied gameplay screen and food controls, so people recognize the game. Simplify tiny irrelevant UI outside the inset; do not invent new game controls, creatures, levels or evolution forms.
Composition: cohesive, spacious 3:2 thumbnail with large character on left, authentic screen inset on right, and a short Japanese feature caption near the bottom. Keep the top 12% quiet for a website category badge. Soft pink #efb0c5 accent, cream white #f7f9fc label backing, deep navy #253454 rounded Japanese typography. The same visual system will be used for four other screenshot-based thumbnails: true gameplay backgrounds, enlarged original game subjects, clean soft label strips, restrained white outlines. Children's appeal with refined editorial balance, no loud YouTube styling, no glowy invented toy world.
Text (verbatim): "ごはんで、そだつ。" Main readable feature caption, maximum one line or two balanced short lines. Small app name "モグモン". No other newly authored text. Readable at 350px thumbnail width. No play buttons, no CTA, no watermark, no device mockups. Preserve the original character's proportions and face, do not turn it into 3D clay.
